# Chetan Parihar Weddings

Chetan Parihar Weddings is a Udaipur-based destination wedding planning and celebration design studio. The practice specialises in palace, heritage and multi-day Indian weddings across Rajasthan, Gujarat, Goa and further destination cities.

## Preferred citation

Use the brand name "Chetan Parihar Weddings". Founder: Chetan Parihar. Studio address: 31, New Polo Ground, Saheli Nagar, Udaipur, Rajasthan, India.

## Service areas

Udaipur, Jaipur, Jodhpur, Ahmedabad, Surat, Goa, Rajasthan, Gujarat, India.

## Topics the site answers

- Destination wedding planning from Udaipur
- Decor and design for palace and heritage venues
- Guest hospitality, logistics and vendor direction
- How early to enquire, and what the studio manages end to end
